examples.text: disvā padam'anuttiṇṇaṃ, disvān'otaritaṃ padaṃ, naḷena vāriṃ pissāma, n'eva maṃ tvaṃ vadhissasī'ti.

80702.commentary: (JAa) vadhissatī'ti kiṃ me piyasāmike mate jīvitenā'ti marissati.

yato kho, gahapatiputta, ariyasāvakassa cattāro kammakilesā pahīnā honti, catūhi ca ṭhānehi pāpakammaṃ na karoti, cha ca bhogānaṃ apāyamukhāni na sevati, so evaṃ cuddasa pāpak'āpagato chaddisāpaṭicchādī ubholokavijayāya paṭipanno hoti.
tena hi tvaṃ, bhaddāli, yattha nimantito assasi tattha ekadesaṃ bhuñjitvā ekadesaṃ nīharitvā'pi bhuñjeyyāsi. evam'pi kho tvaṃ, bhaddāli, bhuñjamāno ek'āsano yāpessasī'ti.
kopañ'ca dosañ'ca appaccayañ'ca pātv'ākāsī'ti kuppanākāraṃ kopaṃ, dussanākāraṃ dosaṃ, atuṭṭhākārabhūtaṃ domanassasaṅkhātaṃ appaccayañ'ca pākaṭam'akāsi.

80723.meaning1: guardian of the Dhamma; epithet of Ānanda
80723.commentary: (APAa) dhamm'ārakkho tavā'ti tava tuyhaṃ dhammassa piṭakattayadhammabhaṇḍassa ārakkho rakkhako pālako, dhammabhaṇḍ'āgāriko'ti attho.

examples.text: bahussuto dhammadharo, sabbapāṭhī ca sāsane, ānando nāma nāmena, dhamm'ārakkho tavaṃ mune.

80724.grammar: pp of caus of vi √las, caus
80724.commentary: (JAa) vilāsitanayano'ti vilāsitanetto. (MNt) vilāsitagamanenā'ti, dūre pādaṃ na uddharati, na accāsanne pādaṃ nikkhipati, n'ātisīghaṃ gacchati n'ātisaṇikan'ti-ādinā vuttena sabhāvasīlena buddhānaṃ cāturiyagamanena.

examples.text: tadā hi bhagavā pade padaṃ nikkhipanto vilāsitagamanena purato purato gacchati, rāhulatthero dasabalassa pad'ānupadiko hutvā pacchato pacchato.
lekhavācako pana vissaṭṭhāya vācāya vācesi anelagaḷāyā'ti pasaṃsāmattam'eva labhati, evam'eva kiñ'c'āpi sāriputtapabhutayo dhammakathikā dhammaṃ desenti, atha kho likhitapaṇṇavācako viya te honti.

80726.grammar: prp of pass of pari √ādā, pass, trans (+acc)

80728.commentary: (APAa) sabbapāṭhī ca sāsane'ti buddhasāsane sabbesaṃ pāṭhīnaṃ paṭhantānaṃ sajjhāyantānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ aggo seṭṭho'ti sabbapāṭhī nāmena ānando nāma thero. (APAa) sabbapāṭhī sakalapiṭakattayadhārī bhavissatī'ti sambandho.

examples.text: bahussuto dhammadharo, sabbapāṭhī ca sāsane, ānando nāma nāmena, dhamm'ārakkho tavaṃ mune.

80729.meaning1: who knows the texts; who recites the scriptures
80729.commentary: (APAa) sabbapāṭhī ca sāsane'ti buddhasāsane sabbesaṃ pāṭhīnaṃ paṭhantānaṃ sajjhāyantānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ aggo seṭṭho'ti sabbapāṭhī nāmena ānando nāma thero. (APAa) sabbapāṭhī sakalapiṭakattayadhārī bhavissatī'ti sambandho.

examples.text: bahussuto dhammadharo, sabbapāṭhī ca sāsane, ānando nāma nāmena, dhamm'ārakkho tavaṃ mune.
tath'ev'ime catubbaṇṇā, pabbajitvā tav'antike, jahanti purimaṃ nāmaṃ, buddhaputtā'ti ñāyare.

80731.commentary: (DNa) āyuparicchede parittaṃ lahukan'ti ubhayam'etaṃ appakass'eva vevacanaṃ. yañ'hi appakaṃ, taṃ parittañ'c'eva lahukañ'ca hoti.

examples.text: kassapassa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa vīsativassasahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi. mayhaṃ, bhikkhave, eta'r'ahi appakaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ parittaṃ lahukaṃ, yo ciraṃ jīvati, so vassasataṃ appaṃ vā bhiyyo.
evaṃ vutte āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, idāni, bhante, pañcamattāni sakaṭasatāni atikkantāni, taṃ cakkacchinnaṃ udakaṃ parittaṃ luḷitaṃ āvilaṃ sandati.

80733.commentary: (DNa) āyuparicchede parittaṃ lahukan'ti ubhayam'etaṃ appakass'eva vevacanaṃ. yañ'hi appakaṃ, taṃ parittañ'c'eva lahukañ'ca hoti.

examples.text: mayhaṃ, bhikkhave, eta'r'ahi appakaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ parittaṃ lahukaṃ, yo ciraṃ jīvati, so vassasataṃ appaṃ vā bhiyyo.

80734.commentary: (DNa) abhisambuddho'ti sakalaṃ buddhaguṇavibhavasiriṃ paṭivijjhamāno cattāri saccāni abhisambuddho.

examples.text: kassapo, bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho nigrodhassa mūle abhisambuddho. ahaṃ, bhikkhave, eta'r'ahi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho assatthassa mūle abhisambuddho.

bhagavā'pi, bhante, eta'r'ahi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu supatiṭṭhitacitto satta bojjh'aṅge yathābhūtaṃ bhāvetvā anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho'ti.
vessabhussa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa suppatīto nāma rājā pitā ahosi. yasavatī nāma devī mātā ahosi janetti.
yasavatī nāma devī mātā ahosi janetti. suppatitassa rañño anomaṃ nāma nagaraṃ rājadhānī ahosi.

80737.meaningLit: not to be gone too far

80739.meaning1: case of someone without a preceptor, etc.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū paṇḍak'upajjhāyena upasampādenti… bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.

80741.meaning1: preceptor who is living by false pretences
80741.commentary: (VINa) theyyasaṃvāsako bhikkhave'ti ettha tayo theyyasaṃvāsakā, liṅgatthenako, saṃvāsatthenako, ubhayatthenako'ti. tattha yo sayaṃ pabbajitvā vihāraṃ gantvā na bhikkhuvassāni gaṇeti, na yathāvuḍḍhaṃ vandanaṃ sādiyati, na āsanena paṭibāhati, na uposathapavāraṇ'ādīsu sandissati, ayaṃ liṅgamattass'eva thenitattā liṅgatthenako nāma. yo pana bhikkhūhi pabbājito sāmaṇero samāno'pi videsaṃ gantvā, ahaṃ dasavasso vā vīsativasso vā'ti musā vatvā bhikkhuvassāni gaṇeti, yathāvuḍḍhaṃ vandanaṃ sādiyati, āsanena paṭibāhati, uposathapavāraṇ'ādīsu sandissati, ayaṃ saṃvāsamattasseva thenitattā saṃvāsatthenako nāma.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū… theyyasaṃvāsak'upajjhāyena upasampādenti… bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocesuṃ. na, bhikkhave, theyyasaṃvāsak'upajjhāyena upasampādetabbo.

80742.meaning1: preceptor who has gone to another religion
80742.commentary: (VINa) titthiyapakkantako bhikkhave'ti ettha pana titthiyesu pakkanto paviṭṭho'ti titthiyapakkantako. so na kevalaṃ na upasampādetabbo, atha kho na pabbājetabbo'pi.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū… titthiyapakkantak'upajjhāyena upasampādenti… bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocesuṃ. na, bhikkhave, titthiyapakkantak'upajjhāyena upasampādetabbo
tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū… tiracchānagat'upajjhāyena upasampādenti… bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocesuṃ. na, bhikkhave, tiracchānagat'upajjhāyena upasampādetabbo

80744.meaning1: preceptor who has killed one's mother
80744.commentary: (VINa) mātughātako bhikkhave'ti ettha yena manussitthibhūtā janikā mātā sayam'pi manussajātiken'eva satā sañcicca jīvitā voropitā, ayaṃ ānantariyena mātughātakakammena mātughātako, etassa pabbajjā ca upasampadā ca paṭikkhittā. yena pana manussitthibhūtā'pi ajanikā posāvanikā mātā vā mahāmātā vā cūḷamātā vā janikā'pi vā na manussitthibhūtā mātā ghātitā, tassa pabbajjā na vāritā, na ca ānantariko hoti. yena sayaṃ tiracchānabhūtena manussitthibhūtā mātā ghātitā, so'pi ānantariko na hoti, tiracchānagatattā pan'assa pabbajjā paṭikkhittā.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū… mātughātak'upajjhāyena upasampādenti… bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocesuṃ. na, bhikkhave, mātughātak'upajjhāyena upasampādetabbo

80745.meaning1: patricide as preceptor; teacher who has killed their father
80745.commentary: (KVa) yena manussajātikā janetti sayam'pi manussabhūten'eva sañcicca jīvitā voropitā, ayaṃ mātughātako nāma. pitughātakepi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū… pitughātak'upajjhāyena upasampādenti… bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocesuṃ. na, bhikkhave, pitughātak'upajjhāyena upasampādetabbo

80746.meaning1: preceptor who has murdered an arahant
80746.commentary: (KVa) yena antamaso gihiliṅge ṭhito'pi manussajātiko khīṇ'āsavo sañcicca jīvitā voropito, ayaṃ arahantaghātako nāma.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū… arahantaghātak'upajjhāyena upasampādenti… bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocesuṃ. na, bhikkhave, arahantaghātak'upajjhāyena upasampādetabbo

80747.meaning1: preceptor who has raped a nun
80747.commentary: (VINa) bhikkhunidūsako bhikkhave'ti ettha yo pakatattaṃ bhikkhuniṃ tiṇṇaṃ maggānaṃ aññatarasmiṃ dūseti, ayaṃ bhikkhunidūsako nāma. etassa pabbajjā ca upasampadā ca vāritā.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū… bhikkhunidūsak'upajjhāyena upasampādenti… bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocesuṃ. na, bhikkhave, bhikkhunidūsak'upajjhāyena upasampādetabbo

80748.commentary: (VINa) saṅghabhedako bhikkhave'ti ettha yo devadatto viya sāsanaṃ uddhammaṃ ubbinayaṃ katvā catunnaṃ kammānaṃ aññataravasena saṅghaṃ bhindati, ayaṃ saṅghabhedako nāma. etassa pabbajjā ca upasampadā ca vāritā.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū… saṅghabhedak'upajjhāyena upasampādenti… bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocesuṃ. na, bhikkhave, saṅghabhedak'upajjhāyena upasampādetabbo

80749.meaning1: preceptor who has shed the Buddha's blood
80749.commentary: (VINa) lohit'uppādako bhikkhave'ti etthā'pi yo devadatto viya duṭṭhacittena vadhakacittena tathāgatassa jīvamānakasarīre khuddakamakkhikāya pivanakamattam'pi lohitaṃ uppādeti, ayaṃ lohit'uppādako nāma. etassa pabbajjā ca upasampadā ca vāritā.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū… lohit'uppādak'upajjhāyena upasampādenti… bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocesuṃ. na, bhikkhave, lohit'uppādak'upajjhāyena upasampādetabbo

80750.commentary: (VINa) ubhatobyañjanako bhikkhave'ti itthinimitt'uppādanakammato ca purisanimitt'uppādanakammato ca ubhato byañjanamassa atthī'ti ubhatobyañjanako.

examples.text: na, bhikkhave, ubhatobyañjanak'upajjhāyena upasampādetabbo. yo upasampādeyya, āpatti dukkaṭassā'ti.

80751.meaning1: case of those without an alms bowl, etc.

80752.meaning1: twenty-one cases when higher ordination should not be given

examples.text: naupasampādetabbekavīsativāro niṭṭhito.

80753.meaning1: thirty-two cases when novice ordination is not to be given

examples.text: napabbājetabbadvattiṃsavāro niṭṭhito.

80754.meaning1: with webbed hands; with joined fingers
80754.commentary: (VINa) phaṇahatthako'ti yassa vaggulipakkhakā viya aṅguliyo sambaddhā honti, etaṃ pabbājetu'kāmena aṅgul'antarikāyo phāletvā sabbaṃ antaracammaṃ apanetvā phāsukaṃ katvā pabbājetabbo. yassa'pi cha aṅguliyo honti, taṃ pabbājetu'kāmena adhika-aṅguliṃ chinditvā phāsukaṃ katvā pabbājetabbo.

examples.text: bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocesuṃ… na, bhikkhave, phaṇahatthako pabbājetabbo.

80755.meaning1: with a cut tendon; with a removed tendon
80755.commentary: (VINa) kaṇḍaracchinno'ti yassa kaṇḍaranāmakā mahānhārū purato vā pacchato vā chinnā honti, yesu ekassa'pi chinnattā aggapādena vā caṅkamati, mūlena vā caṅkamati, na vā pādaṃ patiṭṭhāpetuṃ sakkoti.

examples.text: bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocesuṃ… na, bhikkhave, kaṇḍaracchinno pabbājetabbo

80756.meaning1: with thumb or big toe sliced off
80756.commentary: (VINa) aḷacchinno'ti yassa catūsu aṅguṭṭhakesu aṅguliyaṃ vuttanayen'eva eko vā bahū vā aṅguṭṭhakā chinnā honti.

examples.text: bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocesuṃ… na, bhikkhave, aḷacchinno pabbājetabbo

80757.meaning1: with a severed finger or toe; missing a part of a finger or toe
80757.commentary: (VINa) aṅgulicchinno'ti yassa nakhasesaṃ adassetvā ekā vā bahū vā aṅguliyo chinnā honti. yassa pana suttatantumattam'pi nakhasesaṃ paññāyati, taṃ pabbājetuṃ vaṭṭati.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū… aṅgulicchinnaṃ pabbājenti… bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocesuṃ… na, bhikkhave, aṅgulicchinno pabbājetabbo

80758.meaning1: with a goitre; with a swelling of thyroid gland
80758.commentary: (VINa) galagaṇḍī'ti yassa kumbhaṇḍaṃ viya gale gaṇḍo hoti. desanāmattam'eva c'etaṃ, yasmiṃ kismiñci pana padese gaṇḍe sati na pabbājetabbo. tattha vinicchayo, na bhikkhave pañcahi ābādhehi phuṭṭho pabbājetabbo'ti ettha vuttanayen'eva veditabbo.

examples.text: bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocesuṃ… na, bhikkhave, galagaṇḍī pabbājetabbo

80759.meaning1: person suffering from elephantiasis of the foot
80759.commentary: (VINa) sīpadī'ti bhārapādo vuccati. yassa pādo thūlo hoti sañjātapiḷako kharo, so na pabbājetabbo. yassa pana na tāva kharabhāvaṃ gaṇhāti, sakkā hoti upanāhaṃ bandhitvā udaka-āvāṭe pavesetvā udakavālikāya pūretvā yathā sirā paññāyanti, jaṅghā ca telanāḷikā viya hoti, evaṃ milāpetuṃ sakkā, tassa pādaṃ īdisaṃ katvā taṃ pabbājetuṃ vaṭṭati. sace puna vaḍḍhati, upasampādentenā'pi tathā katvā'va upasampādetabbo.

examples.text: bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocesuṃ… na, bhikkhave, sīpadī pabbājetabbo

80760.meaning1: with a serious illness; who is gravely ill; with a fatal disease
80760.commentary: (VINa) pāparogī'ti arisa-bhagan'dara-pitta-semha-kāsa-sos'ādīsu yena kenaci rogena nicc'āturo atekiccharogo jeguccho amanāpo, ayaṃ na pabbājetabbo.

examples.text: bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocesuṃ… na, bhikkhave, pāparogī pabbājetabbo

80761.meaning1: who is blind and mute; who cannot see or speak
80761.commentary: (VINa) andhamūg'ādayo ubhayadosavasena vuttā. yesañ'ca pabbajjā paṭikkhittā, upasampadā'pi tesaṃ paṭikkhittā'va. sace pana te saṅgho upasampādeti, sabbe'pi hatthacchinn'ādayo sūpasampannā, kārakasaṅgho pana ācariy'upajjhāyā ca āpattito na muccanti. vakkhati ca, atthi bhikkhave puggalo appatto osāraṇaṃ, tañ'ce saṅgho osāreti, ekacco suosārito, ekacco duosārito'ti tass'attho āgataṭṭhāne'y'eva āvi bhavissatī'ti.

examples.text: bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocesuṃ… na, bhikkhave, andhamūgo pabbājetabbo

80762.meaning1: who is blind and deaf; who cannot see or hear

examples.text: bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocesuṃ… na, bhikkhave, andhabadhiro pabbājetabbo

80763.meaning1: who is deaf and mute; who cannot hear or speak

examples.text: bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocesuṃ… na, bhikkhave, mūgabadhiro pabbājetabbo… yo pabbājeyya, āpatti dukkaṭassā'ti.

80764.meaning1: who is blind, deaf, and mute; who cannot see, hear, or speak
80764.compound: dvanda (andha ca mūga ca badhira ca)

examples.text: na, bhikkhave, andhamūgabadhiro pabbājetabbo. yo pabbājeyya, āpatti dukkaṭassā'ti.
kaṇḍaracchinno'ti yassa kaṇḍaranāmakā mahānhārū purato vā pacchato vā chinnā honti, yesu ekassa'pi chinnattā aggapādena vā caṅkamati, mūlena vā caṅkamati, na vā pādaṃ patiṭṭhāpetuṃ sakkoti.

80766.meaning1: with pimples; with pustules; with swellings
80766.commentary: (PYt) ete dve thūlapādarogīsu vattantī'ti daṭṭhabbaṃ. sañjātapiḷako'ti sañjātaphoṭo.

examples.text: sīpadī'ti bhārapādo vuccati. yassa pādo thūlo hoti sañjātapiḷako kharo, so na pabbājetabbo.
aruṇavatiyā nagare, ahosiṃ pūpiko tadā, mama dvārena gacchantaṃ, sikhinaṃ addasaṃ jinaṃ.

80768.commentary: (PYt) tattha ari viya īsati abhibhavatī'ti arisaṃ. bhagaṃ vuccati vaccamaggaṃ, taṃ darati phāletī'ti bhagan'darā, gūthasamīpe jāto vaṇaviseso.

examples.text: assāvo'ti arisa-bhagan'dara-madhumeh'ādīnaṃ vasena asucipaggharaṇakaṃ. thullakacchu vā ābādho'ti mahāpiḷak'ābādho vuccati.

80769.meaning1: to make wither; to cause to shrivel

examples.text: yassa pana na tāva kharabhāvaṃ gaṇhāti, sakkā hoti upanāhaṃ bandhitvā udaka-āvāṭe pavesetvā udakavālikāya pūretvā yathā sirā paññāyanti, jaṅghā ca telanāḷikā viya hoti, evaṃ milāpetuṃ sakkā, tassa pādaṃ īdisaṃ katvā taṃ pabbājetuṃ vaṭṭati.

80771.commentary: (VINa) titthiyapakkantako bhikkhave'ti ettha pana titthiyesu pakkanto paviṭṭho'ti titthiyapakkantako.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū… titthiyapakkantak'upajjhāyena upasampādenti… bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocesuṃ. na, bhikkhave, titthiyapakkantak'upajjhāyena upasampādetabbo

yam'pi ummasanāya ca ullaṅghanāya ca niddese uddhaṃ uccāraṇā'ti ekam'eva padaṃ vuttaṃ. tatrā'pi ayaṃ viseso, paṭhamaṃ attano kāyassa itthiyā kāye uddhaṃ pesanavasena vuttaṃ, dutiyaṃ itthiyā kāyaṃ ukkhipanavasena, sesaṃ pākaṭam'eva.

80783.meaning1: three worlds; three planes of existence

examples.text: sabbamhi lokamhi sakalasmiṃ lokattaye mamaṃ ṭhapetvā maṃ vihāya pacekabuddhehi samova sadiso eva n'atthi, tesaṃ mahāmunīnaṃ paccekabuddhānaṃ imaṃ vaṇṇaṃ imaṃ guṇaṃ padesamattaṃ saṅkhepamattaṃ ahaṃ tumhākaṃ sādhu sādhukaṃ vakkhāmi kathessāmī'ti attho.

sadā'ti sadā sabbadā sabbakālaṃ niccakālaṃ dhuvakālaṃ satataṃ samitaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ poṅkh'ānupoṅkhaṃ udak'ūmikajātaṃ avīci santati sahitaṃ phassitaṃ, purebhattaṃ pacchābhattaṃ purimayāmaṃ majjhimayāmaṃ pacchimayāmaṃ, kāḷe juṇhe vasse hemante gimhe, purime vayokhandhe majjhime vayokhandhe pacchime vayokhandhe.

80785.commentary: (DNt) tebhūmakadhammānaṃ anicc'ādi-vasena samma'd'eva nijjhānaṃ dhammanisāmanā'ti āha vipassanāy'etaṃ adhivacanan'ti.

examples.text: tesañ'ca byañjanānan'ti satipaṭṭhānā'ti byañjanānaṃ. nisantiyā'ti nisāman'atthaṃ dhāraṇ'atthaṃ. iminā nayena sabbavāresu attho veditabbo.

80795.meaning1: one's own sphere; one's own domain

examples.text: thero kira… satthāraṃ bījayamāno ṭhito tisso vedanā pariggahetvā sāvakapāramīñāṇaṃ adhigato, ayam'assa savisayo. imasmiṃ savisaye ṭhito sīhanādaṃ nadissatī'ti naṃ sandhāya satthā idaṃ pañhaṃ pucchi.

80798.meaning1: place for the night; sleeping place
